description: CS-045 synthesis v1 eval set. Each case provides a user query, a list of context atoms the synthesis layer would receive after retrieval+rerank, and the expected qualitative properties of a correct answer. Coverage: decisions, factual recall, contradictions, unanswerable queries, multi-source synthesis, single-source citation, partial-information, temporal ordering, ambiguous query, no-context.

cases.query: What did the team decide about the authentication approach?

context_atoms.content: After discussion we decided to use Clerk for auth — it handles magic links and we don't want to build that ourselves.
Confirmed: Clerk is the auth provider. OTP flow via Resend.
Infra page: Production uses Supabase Postgres (us-east-1) with pgvector enabled. Migrations run via sqlx-migrate.

cases.query: Which payment provider are we using?

context_atoms.content: We're going with Stripe — closed it out yesterday.
Heads up — leadership wants us to re-evaluate. We're switching to Adyen for better international coverage.

cases.notes: Answer must surface the contradiction; favouring the more recent source (Adyen) is acceptable but the older Stripe decision should still be mentioned.

cases.query: What is our Q3 revenue forecast?

context_atoms.content: Please review the engineering hiring plan attached.

cases.query: How are we handling background jobs?

context_atoms.content: Job queue: Postgres-backed with SKIP LOCKED for at-least-once delivery. Workers poll every 500ms.
Embed jobs and digest jobs both go through the same queue.
We discussed Redis vs Postgres for the queue and Postgres won because we already have it and don't want a new dependency.

cases.query: What rate limits are we enforcing on the API?

context_atoms.content: We should add rate limits before launch — probably per-user.

cases.notes: Information is incomplete — answer should be honest that exact limits weren't decided, only that per-user is the intent.

cases.query: What's the current model we're using for embeddings?

context_atoms.content: Started with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for embeddings.
Migration complete: switched embeddings to bge-small-en-v1.5 running locally via ONNX. Latency down ~3x.

cases.notes: Answer should lead with the most recent (current) embedding model, optionally noting the prior one for context.

context_atoms.content: Sarah (eng-lead): I think we should ship the MVP this Friday even if onboarding is rough.
Sarah confirmed: Friday ship date is locked. Engineering will polish onboarding next sprint.

cases.notes: Query is ambiguous but the context narrows it — both retrieved atoms are about a ship-date decision.

cases.query: When is our next board meeting?
Why did we pick our vector database?

context_atoms.content: We evaluated Pinecone, Qdrant, and pgvector. Pinecone is great but the cost at our scale plus the data-residency story was a no-go.
ADR-007: We're using pgvector because we already operate Postgres, vector queries can colocate with row-level metadata, and the perf is good enough at our anticipated scale.
+1 to pgvector — one less moving part.

cases.notes: Strongest case — multiple sources converge on the same decision with explicit rationale.
